name: Yuan-ti Pureblood
summary: Serpent-folk who can pass for human at a glance. Purebloods are cold and calculating, resist magic and poison, and charm others with innate spells.

age.summary: Purebloods mature like humans and live about as long.

speed.description: Your base walking speed is 30 feet.

languages.description: You can speak, read, and write Common, Abyssal, Draconic.

features.name: Darkvision
features.summary: You see in dim light within 60 feet as if it were bright light, and in darkness as if it were dim light (shades of gray only).

features.name: Innate Spellcasting
features.summary: You know the poison spray cantrip. You can cast animal friendship on snakes at will, and from 3rd level suggestion once per long rest. Charisma is your spellcasting ability.

features.name: Magic Resistance
features.summary: You have advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

features.name: Poison Immunity
features.summary: You are immune to poison damage and the poisoned condition.
